app.title: HACCP Suite
app.subtitle: Food safety management system
module.A01.title: HACCP plan builder
module.A01.summary: 12 Codex steps in a 7-screen wizard: drag-and-drop process flow, hazard analysis, CCP decision tree, OPRP categorisation.
module.A02.title: PRP / OPRP
module.A02.summary: Programmes under ISO/TS 22002-1, periodic assessment checklists, evidence.
module.A03.title: CCP / OPRP monitoring
module.A03.summary: CCP and OPRP register, monitoring records, out-of-limit alerts, automatic nonconformity.
module.A04.title: Traceability and recall
module.A04.summary: Forward and backward tree, traceability test and mock recall with a timer.
module.A05.title: Sanitation
module.A05.summary: Cleaning schedule, CIP/COP, verification by ATP and swabs.
module.A06.title: Pest control
module.A06.summary: Map of monitoring points, inspections, activity trend, contractor.
module.A07.title: Personnel hygiene and training
module.A07.summary: Medical records (clearance and date only), competence matrix, training calendar.
module.A08.title: Allergen management
module.A08.summary: Allergen matrix "raw material → product", cross-contamination, label checks.
module.A09.title: Food defence and food fraud prevention
module.A10.title: Production environment and cold chain
module.A10.summary: Temperature and humidity logs by chambers and lines, deviation alerts.
module.B01.title: Products and recipes / BOM
module.B01.summary: Versioned recipes, specifications of raw materials, packaging and finished products.
module.B02.title: Planning and work orders
module.B02.summary: Work orders, calendar, simplified Gantt chart, basic OEE.
module.B03.title: Batch record
module.B03.summary: Actual consumption of raw material lots, process parameters, yield.
module.C01.title: Warehouse and inventory
module.C02.title: Purchasing and suppliers
module.C02.summary: Rating, approved list, documents (CoA, halal, ISO).
module.C03.title: Shipping and distribution
module.D01.title: Quality control
module.D01.summary: Incoming, in-process and final inspection, batch disposition decision.
module.D02.title: Laboratory (LIMS)
module.D02.summary: Samples, methods, comparison with specification, two-step approval.
module.D03.title: Equipment and calibration
module.D03.summary: Calibration schedule, reminders 7, 15 and 30 days ahead, blocking of overdue equipment.
module.D04.title: Nonconformities and CAPA
module.D04.summary: Source → 5 Whys and Ishikawa (6M) → CAPA → effectiveness check.
module.D05.title: Internal audits and inspections
module.D06.title: Customer complaints
module.D06.summary: Classification, link to batch, trend per million units.
module.D07.title: Documents and records
module.D07.summary: Versions, approval, list of current documents, review.
module.D08.title: Management review and KPI
module.D08.summary: Review inputs and outputs, KPI dashboard, minutes.
module.E01.title: Reporting and audit pack
module.E01.summary: Report builder, export, one-click audit pack.
module.E02.title: Security and administration
module.E02.summary: Users and roles, sign-in log, audit trail, backup, multi-site (draft).

hazard.result.needs_change: Change of step, process or product required
tree.Q1: Q1. Do control measures exist for the identified significant hazard at this or subsequent steps?
tree.Q1a: Q1a. Is control at this step necessary for product safety?
tree.Q2: Q2. Is the step specifically designed to eliminate the hazard or reduce its likelihood to an acceptable level?
tree.Q3: Q3. Could contamination with the identified hazard exceed the acceptable level or increase to an unacceptable level?
tree.Q4: Q4. Will a subsequent step eliminate the hazard or reduce it to an acceptable level?
tree.outcome.NEEDS_CHANGE: Result: modify the step, process or product and return to Q1
oprp.c1: 1. Likelihood of failure of the control measure or significant process deviation
oprp.c3: 3. Is the measure specifically designed to reduce the hazard to an acceptable level
oprp.c4: 4. Effect on and from other control measures
oprp.c5: 5. Possibility to set measurable critical limits and detect failure in time
oprp.outcome.CCP_CANDIDATE: CCP candidate: review the decision tree answers

wizard.revised: A new plan version (draft) has been created
wizard.readOnly: This plan version is read-only. Changes are made through a revision (new version).
wizard.hint.1: List the multidisciplinary HACCP team, roles and competences.
wizard.hint.3: Change the order of steps by dragging or with the ↑ ↓ buttons. The flow diagram must be confirmed on site.
wizard.hint.4: Significance: likelihood × severity ≥ {threshold} or severity 3 (DEMO setting). Non-significant hazards are controlled by PRP.
wizard.hint.5: Answer the decision tree questions for each significant hazard; every answer needs a justification. For "not a CCP" — OPRP categorisation.
wizard.hint.6: For each CCP and OPRP set parameters, limits, monitoring method and frequency, equipment and corrective action. Records appear in the A03 register.
wizard.noControlled: No hazards resulting in CCP or OPRP
wizard.readyForApproval: All screens are complete — the plan can be submitted for approval
